author: root Codex personal architecture design; next candidate, not implemented
name: 许可确认前后的统一载荷存储与引用转移
why_now: A separate bounded prefix cache after IOMMU can reproduce late-permission reuse without raw DMA adoption, but duplicates history and later DMA payload storage. A next useful question is whether optional history and mandatory copy payload can share actual cells while preserving independent permission and issuer progress.
initial_scope: Two flows, aligned full 64-bit Normal words, frozen stable immutable source, original reads in legal source-order window, no concurrent mapping revocation, no MMIO/atomics/overlapping source writes. Pending history never authorizes own logical R/W.

resource_contract.payload_pool: P=Q_V+Q_A=6 real word cells, Q_V=Q_A=3. Existing independent byte FIFOs would be replaced, not called free unused storage. No separate history payload array.
resource_contract.tokens: Existing/changed per-flow committed FIFO token queues, plus charged bounded pending-history cell IDs/cursor and per-cell committed/optional reference masks. Cell IDs and ownership metadata are additional cost.
resource_contract.credit: Each flow has at most its real reserved Q references: pending and committed for A count together, not as two free quotas. An optional A ref never consumes V reserved quota. A shared cell can be charged by both logical quotas while consuming one physical payload cell.
resource_contract.ports: One actual incoming source payload write; W data lookup/held-VALID staging and multiple requester read ports or pre-owner mux must be explicitly priced. No BRAM/LUT/timing claim from payload-cell count alone.

rule: On an authorized V source word, allocate one actual cell under V mandatory credit and its normal copy token; optionally record the same cell in A contiguous history list under an A pending credit. Do not copy payload and do not advance A logical R.

While V mandatory reference remains, A optional reference alone cannot make the issuer wait. When V consumes its true W, drop V reference; if A retains its reserved pending credit, keep cell for A, otherwise discard optional ref. Return V logical credit after actual V consumption.

Stop accepting A history at its quota or the first missed source offset; retain the contiguous prefix and record permanent gap. V uses its independently reserved Q and continues under its own actual write/progress conditions.

After actual own A READ grant and PA/attrs/order/generation verification, convert one pending history reference to committed A copy ownership atomically with an original logical A R handshake. Move a cell ID into A copy FIFO without another payload write or second occupancy charge.

A successful original R progress and FIFO data ownership must change together. A failed permission/mismatch drops pending refs before any A exposure; normal independent read or real failed-job path follows.

A true W consumes its committed token; free payload only after every actual committed and retained pending reference is gone. Original source RLAST and every destination W/B/ACK remain separate real obligations.
At a prefix gap, use the one unserved suffix read under original A grant. Replayed logical offsets are not duplicated. New suffix cells allocate under A freed mandatory quota.

capacity_argument.invariant: For each f, pending_f+committed_f <= Q_f; used physical cells <= sum_f(pending_f+committed_f) <= P. Shared cells can make the first inequality strict.
capacity_argument.issuer_progress: A uses at most Q_A cells when disjoint; at least Q_V cells remain available to V across its own drain/arrival obligations. This prevents an unknown recipient from consuming V reserved payload capacity. It does not prove wall-clock isolation from shared W/DDR scheduling or prevent a V permission-related stall.
capacity_argument.reference_transition: Pending->committed changes reference class, not physical cell count or twice-paid per-flow credit. A late grant is not permission to prematurely free original V data.
capacity_argument.scope: A hand invariant, not a checked RTL theorem. Byte masks, spills, multiple jobs/IDs, queue head overlap, flush/error races require a real interface and separate proof.

one_positive_and_neighbor.positive: N8. V streams and writes with Q3 while unknown A retains first3 contiguous words. After V finishes, A history owns3 of6 real cells;3 are free. On matching grant, A converts prefix refs to ordinary logical/copy progress and writes them, then reads/writes only suffix5 with Q3. Physical source dataR13, total realW16, no wrong speculative source read. Ownership transfer incurs no second payload write.
one_positive_and_neighbor.separate_control: Explicit history3 + V nativeFIFO3 + A nativeFIFO3 is9 word payload cells. Under this same simple prefix-retention workload, proposed unified store uses6 word cells, before charged new token/ownership/ports. Both can produce the same R13 bound, so that bound is not a unique algorithm gain.
one_positive_and_neighbor.neighbor: If pending A is allowed to borrow V mandatory quota without a guaranteed reclaim-before-arrival route, A can retain all6 cells and stall V. The fixed per-flow quota rule forbids this but is not itself a new generic partitioning idea.
one_positive_and_neighbor.mismatch_or_denial: Before A progress, release only A optional refs; never cancel V accepted data or free a cell still needed by V. No captured A logical data or target W on denied READ.
one_positive_and_neighbor.unproven_cost: At Q3/64-bit data the nominal saved payload is192bits, potentially smaller than token/control/read-port overhead. Large native Q or SRAM granularity changes cost. No positive total area result is asserted.

actual_interface_gate: Current idma_buffer is byte FIFO only and transport accepted R pushes data/progress together. A unified cell/token implementation needs a changed buffer interface and explicit adopt-cell handshake, aligned datapath initially, paid held-WVALID data ports/staging, actual grant assurance and genuine errors. It cannot be introduced as a transparent zero-cost cache.

novelty_gate.known_primitives: Reference-counted shared payload, zero-copy queues, quotas and ownership transfer are ordinary components. No independent novelty from renaming them.
novelty_gate.could_be_contribution_if: 如果许可未决历史与正常DMA载荷的统一认领合同，在真实RTL中维持原请求/顺序/错误生命周期且同预算减少实际存储或控制成本，且准确最近前作没有相同合同，就可以把该架构差异作为贡献。
novelty_gate.next_decision: Before implementation: obtain exact same-budget state/port accounting and closest shared-buffer or physical-read-cache implementation. If a simple unified post-IOMMU cache has the same contract and cost, use that as architecture and redesign the claimed added rule.

execution: Root positive blueprint and invariant only. No RTL/model/build/board, no area measurement.
